prompts.prompt: Create a production sprite expression atlas for the EXACT SAME chibi anime girl Mira as the supplied reference image. Preserve her identity precisely: huge round cobalt-cyan eyes, blue hair with cyan tips, rounded face, blush, dimensional cobalt-cyan infinity-loop hair ornament, curled infinity ribbon tails behind her. Clean polished anime line art and soft cel shading matching reference. Format: EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows equally sized rectangular cells, one full-body character centered in EACH cell, all characters at identical scale and baseline, 12 percent transparent padding on every side of each cell, no overlap between cells. The four cells must be: TOP LEFT gentle happy SMILE, relaxed arms down, both eyes open; TOP RIGHT playful cute WINK, one eye closed and hands by cheeks, tiny excited pose; BOTTOM LEFT adorably ANGRY, puffed cheeks, furrowed eyebrows and arms folded; BOTTOM RIGHT BORED daydreaming, half-lidded eyes, one hand touching cheek. All four must be visibly different FACIAL EXPRESSIONS and hand poses, not the same smiling face. Keep head size, hair, costume and body proportions consistent across all four cells. Full body, both shoes visible with generous margins. Wholesome fully clothed. Genuinely transparent alpha background, NO grid lines, NO printed checkerboard, NO text labels, NO cast shadows, NO extra objects. This will be sliced at the exact horizontal and vertical midpoint into four sprites. Outfit: her original elegant blue-and-white frilled dress with navy capelet, cyan trim, small infinity brooch, white socks and rounded blue Mary Jane shoes. Match reference costume exactly.
